Returns 0 when the word 0x08eba174 is 0; otherwise 0x10 when side equals the u16 0x08eba176, else 8. No side effects. Callers: 3 (audio_voice_on_spell_trap_activate, audio_voice_on_card_play, audio_voice_on_activation_shown).

Sets the duel cut-in mode with thunk_ui_set_cutin_mode_active(active) when it differs from thunk_ui_is_cutin_mode_active(). Side effects: those of ui_set_cutin_mode_active. Callers: 13 (audio_voice_on_summon, audio_voice_on_turn_end, audio_voice_on_card_play, audio_voice_on_duel_start, ...).

rel_duel_mgr turn-change handler: reads the duel set-up buffer (thunk_deck_get_duel_setup_buffer), resets the turn timers and updates the voice mood. In a tag set-up (+0x192 == 2), for the turn side's duelist d (thunk_duel_core_map_side_to_duelist) sets the side's duelist kind from the duelist's u16 at set-up + d x 0x1ac + 0x1a4: offline 0 (human) when below 2, else 1 (CPU); online the local side gets 0 for value 1, 2 for value 0, otherwise thunk_duel_core_set_duelist_kind without a visible kind, and the other side 2 (remote); sets 0x08eba038 = 1, starts the partner-switch UI with thunk_tag_duel_start_partner_switch(side, x, d, callback 0x08e9b9f4), x = 1, 0, 3, 2 for d = 3, 2, 1, 0, and queues voice event 5. Then, for a CPU duelist, stacks the deck card at set-up + d x 0x1ac + 0x2f0 on top when allowed; and when player flag 0x17 is clear, the deck is not empty or the draw is skipped, voices are enabled and the character (u16 +0x1a4) has a duel voice, queues voice events 3 with 0x1e (outside tag set-ups only), 1 (d, 2), 0xf (2, mood of the side), 2 and 4. No return value. Side effects: duelist kinds, turn timers, 0x08eba038, the partner-switch UI, deck stacking, the voice queue. Callers: 1 (audio_voice_dispatch_ui_event).
Copies the u16 *src to *dst and returns dst. Side effects: writes *dst. Callers: 1 (audio_voice_on_card_moved).
Copies the 16-byte UI event src[0..3] to dst and returns dst. Side effects: writes dst[0..3]. Callers: 1 (audio_voice_dispatch_ui_event).

Returns 1 for a duel that is not a network duel (thunk_system_get_net_active_flag() == 0) and whose set-up uses the default rules (duel_core_setup_has_default_rules: LP mode +0x196 and time limit +0x197 both 0); otherwise 0. No side effects. Callers: 2 (ui_duel_result_init, ui_duel_result_draw_summary_page).

Returns 1 when the duel set-up block (thunk_deck_get_duel_setup_buffer()) has LP mode +0x196 == 0 (8000 LP) and time limit +0x197 == 0, otherwise 0. No side effects. Callers: 2 (duel_core_is_local_default_rules_duel, ui_duel_result_init).

Returns the starting Life Points from the duel set-up block (thunk_deck_get_duel_setup_buffer()) LP mode byte +0x196: 1 -> 2000, 2 -> 4000, 3 -> 12000, 4 -> 16000, 5 -> the custom value u32 +0x198 (side 0) or +0x19c (side != 0), any other value -> 8000. No side effects. Callers: 1 (duel_core_setup_engine_for_duel).

Scans the duellist records (0x1ac bytes each at +0x1a4 of the duel set-up buffer from thunk_deck_get_duel_setup_buffer; 2 records, or 4 when byte +0x192 is 2 = tag) for character u16 +0x00 == 1 (the player): records 0 and 2 set bit 0, records 1 and 3 set bit 1. Returns true when only bit 1 is set (the player duels only on the second side). No side effects. Callers: 1 (duel_core_setup_engine_for_duel).

Resets the four duelist timers (the first four ints of the duel session block returned by thunk_deck_get_duel_setup_tail_block, +0x00..+0x0c) to limit - 1, where the limit comes from the duel set-up buffer (thunk_deck_get_duel_setup_buffer): 0 when mode byte +0x190 is 2, otherwise by time-limit byte +0x197: 1 -> 900, 2 -> 1800 (0x708), 3 -> 5400 (0x1518), 4 -> 9000, else 0 (so -1 = no limit). No return value. Side effects: the four timer words. Callers: 3 (tag_duel_handle_partner_swap, duel_core_setup_engine_for_duel, system_duel_mgr_tutorial_reset_callback).

rel_duel_mgr, every frame: decrements the per-duelist turn timers (words thunk_deck_get_duel_setup_tail_block() + duelist x 4). Offline: for each side, duelist d = thunk_duel_core_map_side_to_duelist(side); when the u16 at set-up buffer +0x1a4 + d x 0x1ac (the duelist record's first u16) is below 2 and the side is awaiting input (thunk_duel_core_is_awaiting_player_input), a positive timer is decremented; then the first of the four duelists whose timer is 0 loses (thunk_duel_core_declare_turn_limit_loss(1) for duelists 1 and 3, (0) for 0 and 2). In a link duel (thunk_system_get_net_active_flag) only duelists whose record u16 +0x0c equals the local peer index are ticked, a timer at 0 declares the loss, and every 30 frames (0x08eba020 % 30) the timer is broadcast (thunk_system_net_api_broadcast_duelist_value). No return value. Side effects: the timers, the loss declaration, the broadcast. Callers: 1 (system_duel_mgr_frame_callback).

Clears the 0x104-byte duel voice queue block 0x08eba068 (16 entries of 16 bytes and a trailing word). Side effects: writes 0x08eba068-0x08eba16b. Callers: 2 (duel_core_setup_engine_for_duel, system_duel_mgr_tutorial_reset_callback).

Copies the 16-byte entry over the duel voice queue entry selected by the index at 0x08eba068 (entries at 0x08eba06c + index x 0x10) with thunk_system_memcpy. Side effects: writes that queue entry. Callers: 1 (audio_voice_queue_process).

Drops the head entry of the 16-entry duel voice queue: when the u16 head index 0x08eba068 differs from the u16 tail index 0x08eba06a, advances the head by 1, wrapping from 15 to 0. Side effects: writes 0x08eba068. Callers: 1 (audio_voice_queue_process).

Sets the versus screen's main timer at [0x08ebaa98] + 0x74 with ui_duel_versus_timer_set(timer, mode, duration) (elapsed cleared). Side effects: writes the timer record. Callers: 2 (ui_duel_versus_update, ui_duel_versus_init).
Clears a versus-screen timer record: byte +0 = 0, u16 +2 = 0, u16 +4 = 0. Side effects: writes the record. Callers: 1 (ui_duel_versus_timer_step).

Reads a versus-screen timer record: *out_elapsed = u16 +2, *out_duration = u16 +4; returns the mode byte +0. Side effects: writes the two outputs. Callers: 1 (ui_duel_versus_get_slide_offset).
